limitations: Success timing percentiles use naturally victorious members only; every win-rate denominator remains100, and natural deaths never count as unresolved.
A budget-exhausted, cancelled, error or invalid result fails acceptance and is never relabelled a gameplay death.
TTK means describe defeated entities only, include approach time, and censor surviving enemies. Histogram rank bucket upper bounds are not exact medians; fusion donors are not kills.
Campaign has no elites; nonapplicable elite TTK is null.
Cast starts need not equal interrupts plus releases: an active cast may end through entity death or run termination. No equality is invented.
One-second HP-loss maxima exclude sacrifice self-cost. They do not prove human completion rates, physical-device smoothness, or absence of every instant-death scenario.
Campaign numeric acceptance does not replace late-endless pressure acceptance, browser QA, latest-head review, Wiki synchronization, or authorized PRE deployment.
